name: Bitpug Electronics Co.
old_description: Bitpug Electronics Co.™ is an electronic parts provider. We currently sell software and files, as well as some hardware. Our goal is to provide electrical equipment to all of central Virginia.
about:
Bitpug Electronics Co. was founded on November 2, 2024, in Columbia, Virginia. The company operates as an American electronics retailer with a stated goal of providing electrical equipment to all of central Virginia.

The company distributes electronic parts and specialized software, and also offers repair services for damaged equipment. It operates a retail store open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, excluding holidays.

Bitpug serves customers throughout central Virginia seeking electronic components, repair services, and related software. No specific industry verticals or named clients are disclosed.

The company’s stated mission is to provide electrical equipment to all of central Virginia, combining parts distribution, repair, and software distribution under one roof.
